Definition: a lance (as thrown); especially the iron point
BiblicalUsage: The Hebrew word rômach means a lance (as thrown); especially the iron point. It stands in 1 Chronicles 12:8, "…handle shield and buckler, whose faces the faces…", and in 1 Kings 18:28, "…cried aloud, and cut themselves after their manner…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God put rômach here on purpose, and I take his word for it.
